newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen steady, looking to HSBC for support.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen steady, looking to HSBC for support.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks look set for sideways trading on Friday, with brokers looking for a firm tone in HSBC shares to offset profit-taking in the property sector.

The Hang Seng Index tumbled 139.91 points to 14,416.57 on Thursday in a decline led mostly by the property stocks. But the Hang Seng London Reference Index later rose 17.47 points to 14,434.04, lifted by an advance in HSBC Holdings.
"Hongkong Bank was strong in London so I doubt the market will go down. It will probably move sideways," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
